README: Customers' own places for the faturete (Assets/Resources/Game/faturete.json), appended by GameDataBuilder (Magistrala/Igra: podaci) after stops.json and the mag-11-19 package points, snapped like the package's house points (nearest open street, edge split there, bay along the street), never onto the D8 / a dual carriageway / a ramp. gx / gz: game coordinates (x east, z south; Unity x = gx, z = -gz via W.U). street: the street it is meant to snap to (the import warns when the snap lands on another). Picked on the streets of our graph (graph.json + overrides + mag-11-20 outside streets) in each village, names from OSM (© OpenStreetMap contributors).
